detail.command: B=$(ls dist/assets/index-*.js | head -1); echo "BUNDLE=$B"; for s in rapier RAPIER green-hills pirate-bay candy-factory ancient-temple arctic-base volcano neon-city haunted-mansion space-station chaos-dimension MatchManager TurnManager HoleSystem ScoreManager RatingSystem CameraController HoleSceneBuilder BotPlanner BotTurnScheduler Minimap MatchRewards maxShots teleporter conveyor lava powerMeter; do printf '%-20s %s\n' "$s" "$(grep -o "$s" "$B" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"; done; echo '--- SRC TREE ---'; find src -name '*.ts' -not -name '*.test.ts' | sort | head -120; echo '--- COUNTS ---'; find src -name '*.ts' -not -name '*.test.ts' | wc -l; find src -name '*.test.ts' | wc -l; echo '--- TESTS DIR ---'; ls tests 2>/dev/null
